562	// LayerNorm bwd for `nrows` rows: dy [rows×d] fp32, cached xhat/inv → dx [rows×d]
563	// fp32; ACCUMULATES dgamma/dbeta (summed over the tile's rows) into a per-CTA
564	// LN-vec partial slot gw/gb [d] (plain += : single owner thread per feature j
565	// across rows, deterministic — same rule as the scalar dec_layernorm_bwd).
566	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_ln_bwd_tile(
567	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
568	        const float* __restrict__ inv, const float* __restrict__ gamma, int nrows,
569	        float* __restrict__ dx, float* __restrict__ gw, float* __restrict__ gb,
570	        float* red) {
571	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
572	        float dgw = 0.0f, dgb = 0.0f;
573	        for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
574	            float d = dy[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j];
575	            dgb += d; dgw += d * xhat[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j];
576	        }
577	        gw[j] += dgw; gb[j] += dgb;
578	    }
579	    for (int s = 0; s < nrows; ++s) {
580	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * dec::kD;
581	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * dec::kD;
582	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
583	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
584	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j]; sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
585	        }
586	        sda = dec_block_sum(sda, red);
587	        sdax = dec_block_sum(sdax, red);
588	        float iv = inv[s];
589	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < dec::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
590	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
591	            dx[(int64_t)s * dec::kD + j] = iv * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)dec::kD);
592	        }
593	        __syncthreads();
594	    }
595	}

597	// Per-sample causal self-attention FORWARD over a tile. qkv is bf16 HBM
598	// [rows×3d] (q|k|v). Writes ctx fp32 HBM [rows×d] and attn weights fp32 to
599	// `attn_w` [nSamp×H×S×S]. Each (sample,head,qpos) row is owned by one thread —
600	// identical math to dec_forward_sample's attention block, looped over samples.
601	__device__ __forceinline__ void dectc_attn_fwd_tile(
602	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ qkv, int nrows,
603	        float* __restrict__ ctx, float* __restrict__ attn_w) {
604	    const int nsamp = nrows / dec::kSeq;
605	    const float scale = dec::attn_scale();
606	    const int rows_per = nsamp * dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq;   // (sample,head,qpos)
607	    for (int r = threadIdx.x; r < rows_per; r += blockDim.x) {
608	        const int si = r / (dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq);
609	        const int rem = r % (dec::kHeads * dec::kSeq);
610	        const int hh = rem / dec::kSeq, qi = rem % dec::kSeq;
611	        const int qoff = hh * dec::kDhead;
612	        const int rbase = si * dec::kSeq;        // first row of this sample
613	        const __nv_bfloat16* qrow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + qi) * 3 * dec::kD + qoff;
614	        float maxs = -CUDART_INF_F; float sc[dec::kSeq];
615	        #pragma unroll
616	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) {
617	            if (kj > qi) { sc[kj] = -CUDART_INF_F; continue; }
618	            const __nv_bfloat16* krow = qkv + (int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * dec::kD + dec::kD + qoff;
619	            float dot = 0.0f;
620	            #pragma unroll
621	            for (int t = 0; t < dec::kDhead; ++t)
622	                dot += __bfloat162float(qrow[t]) * __bfloat162float(krow[t]);
623	            sc[kj] = dot * scale; maxs = fmaxf(maxs, sc[kj]);
624	        }
625	        float denom = 0.0f;
626	        #pragma unroll
627	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) {
628	            float e = (kj <= qi) ? __expf(sc[kj] - maxs) : 0.0f; sc[kj] = e; denom += e;
629	        }
630	        float invd = 1.0f / denom;
631	        float* aw = attn_w + ((int64_t)(si * dec::kHeads + hh) * dec::kSeq + qi) * dec::kSeq;
632	        #pragma unroll
633	        for (int kj = 0; kj < dec::kSeq; ++kj) aw[kj] = sc[kj] * invd;
634	        #pragma unroll
635	        for (int t = 0; t < dec::kDhead; ++t) {
636	            float acc = 0.0f;
637	            #pragma unroll
638	            for (int kj = 0; kj <= qi; ++kj) {
639	                float vv = __bfloat162float(qkv[(int64_t)(rbase + kj) * 3 * dec::kD + 2 * dec::kD + qoff + t]);
640	                acc += aw[kj] * vv;
641	            }
642	            ctx[(int64_t)(rbase + qi) * dec::kD + qoff + t] = acc;
643	        }
644	    }
645	    __syncthreads();
646	}

648	// Global SAMPLE index of the si-th sample in a tile whose first token row is g0.
649	__device__ __forceinline__ int si_global(int g0, int si) { return g0 / dec::kSeq + si; }

651	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
652	//  FORWARD over one TOKEN TILE (nrows = nsamp samples × kSeq positions), global
653	//  token rows [g0, g0+nrows). Tile-batched: the four per-layer linears
654	//  (in_proj/out_proj/ff0/ff2) run on wgmma (M=nrows, N-tiled); attention/LN/
655	//  GELU are scalar fp32 over the tile; head/CE are scalar per-sample (M=nsamp<
656	//  64). Writes the DecActs X-inputs (bf16 dW operands), the per-CTA tile scratch
657	//  (qkv/ff0pre/attn/LN caches/x1/finalin/logits the bwd needs), and returns the
658	//  tile's summed NLL (thread 0 holds it). `tok_ids`/`tgt_ids` are HBM int32.
659	//
660	//  DATAFLOW (DecActs X-regions = bf16 dW operands AND inter-stage operands;
661	//  dedicated fp32 scratch for residuals/LN; weights convert fp32→bf16 on read):
662	//    X_in[li]  := layer input (bf16)           [embedding for li=0]
663	//    qkv(bf16) := X_in @ in_w^T + in_b   (in_b folded fp32 → re-round bf16)
664	//    ctx       := attn(qkv) → X_ctx[li] (bf16, out_proj input + dW operand)
665	//    a(work)   := X_ctx @ out_w^T ; r1=X_in+a+out_b (work); n1(r1)→x1(fp32)→X_x1[li]
666	//    ff0(work) := X_x1 @ ff0_w^T ; (ff0+ff0_b)→ff0pre(bf16); gelu(ff0+ff0_b)→X_gact[li](bf16)
667	//    ff2(work) := X_gact @ ff2_w^T ; r2=x1+ff2+ff2_b (work); n2(r2)→X_in[li+1]
668	//                 (last layer: n2→finalin fp32, the head input)
669	//  BIASES (in/out/ff0/ff2) are folded in fp32 at these points (the oracle adds
670	//  them in fp32 after the bf16 matmul); LN β + head out_b were already applied.
671	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
672	__device__ float dectc_forward_tile(
673	        const DecWeights& w, int g0, int nrows, const DecActs& acts,
674	        const DecTileScratch& sc, const int* __restrict__ tok_ids,
675	        const int* __restrict__ tgt_ids,
676	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB, float* red) {
677	    const int nsamp = nrows / dec::kSeq;
678	    // ── Embedding: X_in[0][r] = tok[token_id[g0+r]] + pos[(g0+r)%S]. bf16. ──
679	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
680	        const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
681	        const int g = g0 + r;
682	        const int tid = tok_ids[g];
683	        const int sp = g % dec::kSeq;            // position within the sample
684	        float v = w.tok[(int64_t)tid * dec::kD + j] + w.pos[(int64_t)sp * dec::kD + j];
685	        acts.X_in[0][(int64_t)g * dec::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(v);
686	    }
687	    __syncthreads();
688	
689	    for (int li = 0; li < dec::kLayers; ++li) {
690	        const DecWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
691	        const __nv_bfloat16* Xin = acts.X_in[li] + (int64_t)g0 * dec::kD;        // [nrows,d]
692	        // qkv = Xin @ in_w^T + in_b   (N=3d, K=d). bf16 → scratch.qkv[li].
693	        dectc_gemm_fwd<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(Xin, L.in_w, sc.qkv[li], dec::kD, 3 * dec::kD, sA, sB);
694	        __syncthreads();
695	        // add in_b (the fwd GEMM did W only; bias folded in scalar here for qkv —
696	        // matches the bf16-faithful oracle qkv = bf(x_in @ bf(in_w)^T + in_b)).
697	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * 3 * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
698	            const int j = idx % (3 * dec::kD);
699	            float v = __bfloat162float(sc.qkv[li][idx]) + L.in_b[j];
700	            sc.qkv[li][idx] = __float2bfloat16(v);
701	        }
702	        __syncthreads();
703	        // attention → ctx (work fp32) + attn[li] weights.
704	        dectc_attn_fwd_tile(sc.qkv[li], nrows, sc.work, sc.attn[li]);
705	        // ctx bf16 → X_ctx[li] (out_proj input + its dW operand).
706	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
707	            const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
708	            acts.X_ctx[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * dec::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(sc.work[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j]);
709	        }
710	        __syncthreads();
711	        // a = X_ctx @ out_w^T (+ out_b)  (N=d, K=d). fp32 → work.
712	        dectc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_ctx[li] + (int64_t)g0 * dec::kD, L.out_w,
713	                                            sc.work, dec::kD, dec::kD, sA, sB);
714	        __syncthreads();
715	        // r1 = Xin + a + out_b → work (fp32). out_b folded here (the GEMM did W only)
716	        // — matches the oracle a = ctx_b @ out_w^T + out_b kept fp32 through r1.
717	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
718	            const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
719	            sc.work[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j] += __bfloat162float(Xin[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j]) + L.out_b[j];
720	        }
721	        __syncthreads();
722	        // n1(r1) → x1 (fp32) + caches[li]; then bf16 → X_x1[li] (ff0 input + dW operand).
723	        dectc_ln_fwd_tile(sc.work, L.n1_w, L.n1_b, nrows, sc.x1, sc.n1x[li], sc.n1i[li], red);
724	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
725	            const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
726	            acts.X_x1[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * dec::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(sc.x1[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j]);
727	        }
728	        __syncthreads();
729	        // ff0 = X_x1 @ ff0_w^T (+ ff0_b)  (N=dff, K=d). fp32 → work; (pre+b) bf16 →
730	        // ff0pre; gelu(pre+b) → X_gact[li] (bf16, ff2 input + dW operand). ff0_b folded
731	        // into pre (fp32) — matches the oracle ff0pre=bf(ff0+b), gact=bf(gelu(ff0+b)).
732	        dectc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_x1[li] + (int64_t)g0 * dec::kD, L.ff0_w,
733	                                            sc.work, dec::kD, dec::kDff, sA, sB);
734	        __syncthreads();
735	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kDff; idx += blockDim.x) {
736	            const int r = idx / dec::kDff, j = idx % dec::kDff;
737	            float pre = sc.work[(int64_t)r * dec::kDff + j] + L.ff0_b[j];
738	            sc.ff0pre[li][(int64_t)r * dec::kDff + j] = __float2bfloat16(pre);
739	            acts.X_gact[li][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * dec::kDff + j] = __float2bfloat16(dec_gelu(pre));
740	        }
741	        __syncthreads();
742	        // ff2 = X_gact @ ff2_w^T (+ ff2_b) (N=d, K=dff). fp32 → work.
743	        dectc_gemm_fwd_f32<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(acts.X_gact[li] + (int64_t)g0 * dec::kDff, L.ff2_w,
744	                                            sc.work, dec::kDff, dec::kD, sA, sB);
745	        __syncthreads();
746	        // r2 = x1 + ff2 + ff2_b → work (fp32). x1 lives in the dedicated fp32 buffer
747	        // (no bf16 round). ff2_b folded here — matches the oracle r2 = x1 + (ff2 + ff2_b).
748	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
749	            const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
750	            sc.work[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j] += sc.x1[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j] + L.ff2_b[j];
751	        }
752	        __syncthreads();
753	        if (li + 1 < dec::kLayers) {
754	            // n2(r2) → finalin (fp32 reused) + n2 caches[li]; bf16 → X_in[li+1].
755	            dectc_ln_fwd_tile(sc.work, L.n2_w, L.n2_b, nrows, sc.finalin, sc.n2x[li], sc.n2i[li], red);
756	            for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < nrows * dec::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
757	                const int r = idx / dec::kD, j = idx % dec::kD;
758	                acts.X_in[li + 1][(int64_t)(g0 + r) * dec::kD + j] = __float2bfloat16(sc.finalin[(int64_t)r * dec::kD + j]);
